Keeping peptides cool in Peoria

Peoria's weather figures here come from NOAA's 1991 to 2020 normals for the nearby Youngtown station, at about 1,135 feet.9 July there averages a high of 104.9 °F and a low of 79.7 °F.9 The station averages 115.3 days a year at or above 100 °F and 175.4 at or above 90 °F, a few more on both counts than Phoenix Sky Harbor's 111.3 and 173.4.510 July nights run about 5 °F cooler than at the airport, where lows average 84.5 °F.911 Rain is scarce, at 8.34 inches in a normal year.5

Recent years have set records as well. The National Weather Service in Phoenix ranked 2024 as the warmest year in Phoenix's recorded history and 2025 as the second warmest, and in 2024 a run of very hot days lasted well into October.1213 Autumn deliveries can meet summer heat too.

Heat in transit and heat after delivery are separate questions. Bachem typically ships its own freeze-dried peptides at ambient temperature and prints the recommended long-term storage condition on the label.7 After delivery, follow the condition stated for the product in hand, because freeze-dried products do not share one rule. FDA labels put EGRIFTA SV (tesamorelin) vials at room temperature, 20 to 25 °C (68 to 77 °F), and ZOMACTON (somatropin) vials in a refrigerator at 2 to 8 °C (36 to 46 °F).1415

The EGRIFTA SV label allows excursions from 15 to 30 °C (59 to 86 °F), one product's tested limit rather than a rule for other peptides.14 A July afternoon at Youngtown averages 104.9 °F, about 40 °C, well past even that range.9 The storage guide covers refrigerator and freezer storage step by step.

About Peoria

Peoria counted 108,364 residents in the 2000 census, 154,065 in 2010 and 190,985 in 2020.161718 The Census Bureau's July 2025 estimate, 200,881, is the first above 200,000; the July 2024 figure was 198,735.1 The city spans 177.45 square miles of land and 3.17 square miles of water.8

Lake Pleasant lies at least partly within city limits. Census map data show the lake as two named water areas, and the internal point of each falls inside Peoria, one in Maricopa County and one in Yavapai County.234 The lake is a Central Arizona Project reservoir in the 23,362-acre Lake Pleasant Regional Park, and its water surface covers anywhere from more than 3,000 acres up to almost 10,000 acres when the reservoir is full.19

The Peoria Sports Complex was the first two-team spring training facility when it opened in 1994.20 The San Diego Padres and Seattle Mariners share its 145 acres in the city's P83 Entertainment District, and both teams' leases run through 2034.20

In Sun City, Banner Sun Health Research Institute has worked on memory and movement disorders since it was founded in 1986, through research, clinical care, prevention and education.21 Banner says it serves Peoria, Surprise, the Sun Cities and nearby areas.21 Its Brain and Body Donation Program studies aging and age-related disease in older volunteers from the Phoenix area.22 Banner names Arizona State University, the University of Arizona, Midwestern University and Mayo Clinic in Arizona among the program's research partners.22 Midwestern University, a private, nonprofit graduate university for the health sciences, has its Arizona campus on 156 acres in Glendale, 15 miles northwest of downtown Phoenix.23 Within Peoria, Valleywise Health announced the opening of its Valleywise Comprehensive Health Center, Peoria, at Grand Avenue and Cotton Crossing in January 2021.24

Nearby

Pages for nearby places cover Glendale, home of Midwestern University's Arizona campus, along with Surprise and Anthem.23 Spring training carries on in Surprise, where the Texas Rangers and Kansas City Royals share Surprise Stadium.25 For the whole county, start at Peptides in Phoenix; the locations page lists every city and town with a page.

Frequently asked questions

Do you ship research peptides to Peoria, Arizona?

Yes. Peoria orders ship from the USA and Canada and follow the shipping policy that applies to every order across the United States. Before checkout, each product page shows its strengths and whether it is in stock. D2C Peptides keeps no address in Peoria, so the city is served by shipping only, and questions about an order go through the contact page.

Which ZIP codes does Peoria cover?

By land, most of Peoria lies in four ZIP Code Tabulation Areas: 85383, which alone covers about 71 percent of the city, plus 85345, 85382 and 85381. About 11 percent of the city lies in 85324, a large area that mostly sits outside it, and slivers fall in about a dozen others.6 These Census areas approximate Postal Service ZIP codes, and orders to any of them follow the same policy.

How should a delivered parcel be stored in a Peoria summer?

Bring it inside soon after delivery, then store each vial as its product page's storage section directs. As general guidance, Bachem, a peptide maker, says freeze-dried peptides may be kept in a refrigerator at 4 °C (39 °F) for short-term use, and colder for longer storage.7 A box left on a porch is the risk to avoid: the nearby Youngtown weather station averages 115.3 days a year at or above 100 °F.5

Can Peoria customers order these peptides for personal use?

No. Every product is sold for laboratory research and carries the notice "For research use only. Not for human or veterinary use." The research use policy sets the terms of sale. What the information on this site can and cannot do is set out in the medical disclaimer, and any question about a treatment or a health condition belongs with a licensed clinician.
